items.title_en: Qatar’s 13-Year-Old Volleybal Giant Raises Eyebrows at Asian Championship
items.title_zh: 卡塔尔13岁排坛巨人亚锦赛令人瞩目
items.summary_en: Qatar didn’t have the most impressive performance at this year’s Asian Volleyball Championship, losing all three games in its group stage against Thailand, Taipei, and South Korea, but it did stand out thanks to one of the most prolific scorers of the tournament – 13-year-old Mubarak Musa Thiik Madut, who scored 40 points in the three matches, more than any of his teammates. items.title_en: Blind Man With No Driver’s License Drinks and Drives Car 150 Miles on Highway
items.title_zh: 无驾照盲人酒驾高速公路150英里
items.summary_en: In the early morning hours of June 29, when English officers patrolling the M6 motorway near Carlisle noticed an Opel Meriva swerving chaotically from one lane to the next, they thought they had caught a reckless motorist, but they were in for a big surprise. Not only was the driver visibly drunk, but he had no driver’s license and was almost completely blind! At a recent hearing, Anthony Hall admitted to drink-driving, driving without a licence or insurance and taking his partner’s car without their consent. His…
items.summary_zh: 6月29日凌晨，当英国警察在卡莱尔附近的M6高速公路上巡逻时，发现一辆欧宝梅里瓦混乱地从一条车道转向另一条车道，他们以为自己抓住了一名鲁莽的驾车者，但他们大吃一惊。司机不仅明显喝醉了，而且没有驾照，而且几乎完全失明！在最近的一次听证会上，安东尼·霍尔承认酒后驾驶、无证驾驶或无保险驾驶，并接受了驾驶执照。
